commands.label: write-readme-unix-lf
commands.note: Write D:\claude_boot\README.txt with Unix LF (no CRLF). Complete boot+setup instructions readable from Alpine at /media/usb/claude_boot/README.txt
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\claude_boot' | Out-Null; $lines = @('ALPINE LINUX CLAUDE CLI - COMPLETE SETUP GUIDE','==============================================','Built: 2026-10-28 | Drive: D:\ (Ventoy USB)','','FILES ON THIS DRIVE','-------------------','  D:\alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso  <- boot this','  D:\localhost.apkovl.tar.gz            <- auto-login overlay (Alpine loads at boot)','  D:\ventoy\ventoy.json                 <- autoboot config (5s timeout)','  D:\claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh    <- run this after boot','  D:\claude_boot\README.txt             <- this file','','STEP 1 - BOOT','-------------','  Restart PC, press F12 (or F11) for boot menu','  Select the Ventoy USB drive','  Alpine Linux entry auto-selects in 5 seconds','  Login: automatic as root (via apkovl overlay)','','STEP 2 - FIRST BOOT NETWORK + SETUP','------------------------------------','  Run: setup-alpine','    > hostname: [enter]','    > interface: eth0 or wlan0','    > ip: dhcp','    > dns: [enter]','    > timezone: UTC (or your zone)','    > disk: none   <-- IMPORTANT: run from RAM','    > lbu media: usb  <-- saves config back to this USB','','STEP 3 - MOUNT THIS USB DRIVE','------------------------------','  mkdir -p /media/usb','  mount /dev/sdb1 /media/usb   (or sdc1 if sdb is your internal drive)','  ls /media/usb/claude_boot/   (verify files visible)','','STEP 4 - RUN CLAUDE CLI SETUP','------------------------------','  sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh','  (installs: nodejs npm git curl + @anthropic-ai/claude-code)','  (takes ~2 min, needs internet)','','STEP 5 - SET API KEY','--------------------','  export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-xxxx','  (add to /root/.profile to persist across reboots)','','STEP 6 - RUN CLAUDE','-------------------','  claude','','STEP 7 - SAVE CONFIG (PERSISTENCE)','-----------------------------------','  After setup, save to USB so next boot is instant:','  umount /media/usb','  lbu commit','  Now packages + config are stored in localhost.apkovl.tar.gz on USB','','NOTES','-----','  - apkovl overlay auto-logins root and runs claude if installed','  - ventoy.json sets VTOY_DEFAULT_MENU_MODE=0 + 5s timeout','  - Go setup script also available: alpine_go_setup.sh (bonus)','  - All files readable from Windows as D:\claude_boot\'); $text = $lines -join "`n"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\claude_boot\README.txt', $text + "`n", [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); Write-Output 'README_UNIX_LF_OK'"
